text_block_list.text:
I spot Mejiro Palmer and some other
runners
training for a race.
Huff... Huff... What a workout!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't be so worn out doing this
kinda thing
though. Especially since our
next race is giving
serious next-level
vibes...
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text: That just means we're next level too! This race 'bout to be a party for real!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
We gotta keep the party vibes going!
We'll go
hard with our runaway strat and
light the stands
on fire!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
Totally! We gotta get, uh... lit! Because
we're next
level!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Oh,I know! Wanna see if my freestyle
racer
friends are up for a race? Running
with them just
hits different.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
The freestyle racers?! Bet! That sounds
fire!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text: Okay, let's get going then! ♪
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! You can come along too if you
want!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer invites me just as their

conversation piques my interest.

I tag along out of a combination of
curiosity and
concern, and when we
arrive...

Hey, everyone! It's been aaages! You
guys are
lookin' great!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Palmer! Look at that tracksuit... I
guess that
means you got in to Tracen
Academy!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Waheeeey! How's it goin', everybody?!
Lemme
hear ya scream!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text: Woo, woo!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
Is this person with you too? Omigosh,
you've got
a badge. Are you a Тренер?!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Yeah, I kinda dragged 'em along.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
All the Umamusume here have their own
reasons
for gathering here to run in this
unofficial race.
So, what's the deal today?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
We've got a race comin' up, so we're
here to get
the vibes goin'.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
So you wanna revisit the good old days,
huh? Hell
yeah! I'll help you out!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Then I'll race you! Work's been stressing
me out,
so I'm ready to pop off!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
Plus, I wanna see what Tracen
Academy's really
made of. I haven't
given up on getting in yet!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's do it!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
The race is held on a quiet country road,
but it's
still a sight to behold.
Haha, we finished at the same time!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Wow, you're the real deal, Palmer!
You've really
improved! You too, Helios!
I've never seen
anyone blast to the front
like that!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Hehe, you guys were legit on fire! I knew I had to go hard or go home!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
This takes me back to my amateur days.
I knew
coming here would make for a
great escape!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
You helped bring back my memories of
this place
today, Helios.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
It's like you're my sun or something! For
real
though, thanks!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Same, bestie! I made a ton of new
friends and got
to run a bunch! Today
high-key slapped!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос
choice_data_list: You two make a good duo.

So for you, "running away" embodies your will
to improve.

text_block_list.text:
Same, bestie! I made a ton of new
friends and got
to run a bunch! Today
high-key slapped!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос
choice_data_list: You two make a good duo.

So for you, "running away" embodies your will
to improve.

text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, we're a perfect pair! Let's have
a blast at
the actual race too!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text: Bet! And after this vibe check, we're gonna serve on the racecourse! No cap!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
On the day of the race, the perfect pair
start the
race by seizing a huge lead...
Wooooo!

(No way! Palmer's absolutely slaying! I
can barely
keep up!)
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text: (But feel that fiery energy! She's giving off main character vibes, like, for real !)
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
GO FOR THE WIN!
PAAAAALMERRRRR!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text: HAAAAAHHHHH!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer triumphantly takes first
place, with
Дайтаку Гелиос right behind
her!
Hahaha! AWESOME!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Congrats!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text: Ack!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text: Whoa?!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
With only a little further to go, the two
runners
lose their steam and fail to keep
ahead of the
pack before reaching the
finish line.

(We didn't make it! But... I feel like I saw
the path
to victory!)
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
(I don't care if people think I'm just some
runaway
fool, I'm not letting things end
this way!)
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
I hate losing, but if I'm gonna be a fool,
then I'm
gonna be a fool to the end!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm gonna run with all I've got.
And when I
do, I'll see just how big the
world really is.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
We'll be there to cheer for you guys too,
so break
a leg, Palmer and Helios!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, bet! Can't have an after-party
without the
whole gang there!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
You always get so ahead of yourself,
Helios!
Anyway, let's run away toward a
future full of fun!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
On the day of the race, the perfect pair
start the
race by seizing a huge lead...
Wooooo!
YEEEEEAAAAAHHHHH!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
(For real?! That was a total serve,
Palmer!)
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
That day, everyone gets to witness how
a little
escape can lead to big things.

Mejiro Palmer stands on the track, eyes
shining
bright with intense
determination.

Thanks, Bestie! That won't be the last
time I make
a great escape!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
